title: Largest Element in Array
description: Find the maximum element in an array using linear scan.

data.text: Given an array `arr`, find the largest element in it.
Compare every element with every other element to find the maximum. O(n²) time.

data.title: Brute Force O(n²)
data.content: Compare every element with every other element to find the maximum.

data.text: Track the maximum while iterating once through the array. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Linear Scan O(n)
data.content: Track the maximum while iterating once through the array.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n²) → O(n). **Space:** O(1) in both. The linear scan is the optimal interview solution.
